title: Wrong-Address Violations After a Batch Pay Reversal — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Rule.** On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, every batch pay reversal booked because an order was verified as not delivered owes one wrong-address violation, booked on the account with the batch that carried the order. A wrong-address violation is booked with its wrong-address severity points. Only one wrong-address violation is booked per pay reversal.

**Timing of the points.** The points a wrong-address violation is booked with are fixed only after every batch the account dropped by its own choice carries its dropped-batch violation entry. Put the other way, while any batch the account dropped by its own choice still lacks its dropped-batch violation entry, the points of a wrong-address violation are not yet fixed.

## When a violation is owed

| The Cartwise Shopper Batches pay ledger shows | Wrong-address violation |
|---|---|
| A pay reversal for an order verified as not delivered, with no wrong-address violation entry yet naming that reversal's batch | One is owed, on the batch that carried the order |
| A pay reversal for any other reason | None under this rule |
| A wrong-address violation entry already matches that reversal | None further |

## Tool: `record_wrong_address_violation_db63d782`

**Capability.** Books a wrong-address violation on a shopper contractor account for a batch on which an order was handed to the wrong address and the batch pay for it was taken back. One call adds one violation entry of type `wrong_address`, dated today and tied to that batch, carrying the violation points given, and raises the account's active violation points by the same number.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks `record_wrong_address_violation_db63d782` and then calls it; it is an agent-side tool.

**Parameters.**

- `shopper_account_id` — the shopper contractor account number the violation is booked on, as returned by the shopper account lookup for the verified caller (account reference, text).
- `batch_id` — the batch number of the batch that carried the order, as shown on the batch earnings entry that took the pay back (batch earnings lookup) and in the batch lookup (batch reference, text).
- `points` — the violation points the entry carries: a whole non-negative integer, no decimals and no sign; the active points rise by exactly this integer.

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("recorded" when the booking succeeded), `violation_entry_id`, `violation_type` (always `wrong_address`), `batch_id` (echoed back), `points` (the integer booked), `violation_points_balance` (the active violation points after the booking) and `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). The violation then shows on the account's list of violations with its points.
